highlights: Core EQ updates itself from the same release feed the other Core apps use.
A real manual equaliser is available on TV, alongside room correction.
Movie / TV, Everyday and Gaming modes layer over the room base.
The Home indicator distinguishes playback from verified coverage.
Optional DUMP discovery can expose additional player sessions.
DynamicsProcessing is now an apply path on API 28+.
A REW measurement can be imported instead of a sweep.
Android 11 (API 30) is now the minimum; Core EQ builds and targets Android 17 (API 37).
